arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا

translations.en.sahih: By those [angels] who extract with violence
translations.en.pickthall: By those who drag forth to destruction,
translations.en.yusufali: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
translations.id.indonesian: Demi (malaikat-malaikat) yang mencabut (nyawa) dengan keras,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] those who remove with ease
translations.en.pickthall: By the meteors rushing,
translations.en.yusufali: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang mencabut (nyawa) dengan lemah-lembut,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
translations.en.pickthall: By the lone stars floating,
translations.en.yusufali: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang turun dari langit dengan cepat,

translations.en.sahih: And those who race each other in a race
translations.en.pickthall: By the angels hastening,
translations.en.yusufali: Then press forward as in a race,
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang mendahului dengan kencang,

translations.en.sahih: And those who arrange [each] matter,
translations.en.pickthall: And those who govern the event,
translations.en.yusufali: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
translations.id.indonesian: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang mengatur urusan (dunia).

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
translations.en.yusufali: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
translations.id.indonesian: (Sesungguhnya kamu akan dibangkitkan) pada hari ketika tiupan pertama menggoncang alam,

translations.en.sahih: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
translations.en.pickthall: And the second followeth it,
translations.en.yusufali: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):
translations.id.indonesian: tiupan pertama itu diiringi oleh tiupan kedua.

translations.en.sahih: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
translations.en.pickthall: On that day hearts beat painfully
translations.en.yusufali: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
translations.id.indonesian: Hati manusia pada waktu itu sangat takut,

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled.
translations.en.pickthall: While eyes are downcast
translations.en.yusufali: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
translations.id.indonesian: Pandangannya tunduk.

transliteration: Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah

translations.en.sahih: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
translations.en.pickthall: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
translations.en.yusufali: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
translations.id.indonesian: (Orang-orang kafir) berkata: "Apakah sesungguhnya kami benar-benar dikembalikan kepada kehidupan semula?

translations.en.sahih: Even if we should be decayed bones?
translations.en.pickthall: Even after we are crumbled bones?
translations.en.yusufali: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah (akan dibangkitkan juga) apabila kami telah menjadi tulang belulang yang hancur lumat?"

translations.en.sahih: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
translations.en.pickthall: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
translations.en.yusufali: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Kalau demikian, itu adalah suatu pengembalian yang merugikan".

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
translations.en.pickthall: Surely it will need but one shout,
translations.en.yusufali: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pengembalian itu hanyalah satu kali tiupan saja,

translations.en.sahih: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! they will be awakened.
translations.en.yusufali: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
translations.id.indonesian: maka dengan serta merta mereka hidup kembali di permukaan bumi.

translations.en.sahih: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
translations.en.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
translations.en.yusufali: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
translations.id.indonesian: Sudah sampaikah kepadamu (ya Muhammad) kisah Musa.

arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
transliteration: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa

translations.en.sahih: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
translations.en.pickthall: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
translations.id.indonesian: Tatkala Tuhannya memanggilnya di lembah suci ialah Lembah Thuwa;

translations.en.sahih: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
translations.en.pickthall: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
translations.en.yusufali: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
translations.id.indonesian: "Pergilah kamu kepada Fir'aun, sesungguhnya dia telah melampaui batas,

arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
translations.en.pickthall: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
translations.en.yusufali: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
translations.id.indonesian: dan katakanlah (kepada Fir'aun): "Adakah keinginan bagimu untuk membersihkan diri (dari kesesatan)".

transliteration: Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha

translations.en.sahih: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
translations.en.pickthall: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
translations.en.yusufali: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kamu akan kupimpin ke jalan Tuhanmu agar supaya kamu takut kepada-Nya?"

translations.en.sahih: And he showed him the greatest sign,
translations.en.pickthall: And he showed him the tremendous token.
translations.en.yusufali: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Musa memperlihatkan kepadanya mukjizat yang besar.

translations.en.sahih: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
translations.en.pickthall: But he denied and disobeyed,
translations.en.yusufali: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi Fir'aun mendustakan dan mendurhakai.

translations.en.sahih: Then he turned his back, striving.
translations.en.pickthall: Then turned he away in haste,
translations.en.yusufali: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian dia berpaling seraya berusaha menantang (Musa).

translations.en.sahih: And he gathered [his people] and called out
translations.en.pickthall: Then gathered he and summoned
translations.en.yusufali: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka dia mengumpulkan (pembesar-pembesarnya) lalu berseru memanggil kaumnya.

translations.en.sahih: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
translations.en.pickthall: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
translations.en.yusufali: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
translations.id.indonesian: (Seraya) berkata: "Akulah tuhanmu yang paling tinggi".

transliteration: Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola.

translations.en.sahih: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
translations.en.pickthall: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
translations.en.yusufali: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Allah mengazabnya dengan azab di akhirat dan azab di dunia.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu terdapat pelajaran bagi orang yang takut (kepada Tuhannya).

arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
transliteration: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.

translations.en.sahih: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
translations.en.pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
translations.en.yusufali: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah kamu lebih sulit penciptaanya ataukah langit? Allah telah membinanya,

translations.en.sahih: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
translations.en.pickthall: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
translations.en.yusufali: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
translations.id.indonesian: Dia meninggikan bangunannya lalu menyempurnakannya,

transliteration: Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha.

translations.en.sahih: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
translations.en.pickthall: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
translations.id.indonesian: dan Dia menjadikan malamnya gelap gulita, dan menjadikan siangnya terang benderang.

translations.en.sahih: And after that He spread the earth.
translations.en.pickthall: And after that He spread the earth,
translations.en.yusufali: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bumi sesudah itu dihamparkan-Nya.

translations.en.sahih: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
translations.en.pickthall: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
translations.en.yusufali: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
translations.id.indonesian: Ia memancarkan daripadanya mata airnya, dan (menumbuhkan) tumbuh-tumbuhannya.

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains He set firmly
translations.en.pickthall: And He made fast the hills,
translations.en.yusufali: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan gunung-gunung dipancangkan-Nya dengan teguh,

translations.en.sahih: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
translations.en.pickthall: A provision for you and for your cattle.
translations.en.yusufali: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
translations.id.indonesian: (semua itu) untuk kesenanganmu dan untuk binatang-binatang ternakmu.

translations.en.sahih: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
translations.en.pickthall: But when the great disaster cometh,
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila malapetaka yang sangat besar (hari kiamat) telah datang.

transliteration: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.

translations.en.sahih: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
translations.en.pickthall: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
translations.en.yusufali: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari (ketika) manusia teringat akan apa yang telah dikerjakannya,

translations.en.sahih: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
translations.en.pickthall: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
translations.en.yusufali: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan diperlihatkan neraka dengan jelas kepada setiap orang yang melihat.

translations.en.sahih: So as for he who transgressed
translations.en.pickthall: Then, as for him who rebelled
translations.en.yusufali: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang yang melampaui batas,

translations.en.sahih: And preferred the life of the world,
translations.en.pickthall: And chose the life of the world,
translations.en.yusufali: And had preferred the life of this world,
translations.id.indonesian: dan lebih mengutamakan kehidupan dunia,

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! hell will be his home.
translations.en.yusufali: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;
translations.id.indonesian: maka sesungguhnya nerakalah tempat tinggal(nya).

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
transliteration: Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
translations.en.pickthall: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
translations.en.yusufali: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun orang-orang yang takut kepada kebesaran Tuhannya dan menahan diri dari keinginan hawa nafsunya,

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
translations.en.yusufali: Their abode will be the Garden.
translations.id.indonesian: maka sesungguhnya surgalah tempat tinggal(nya).

translations.en.sahih: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
translations.en.pickthall: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
translations.en.yusufali: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
translations.id.indonesian: (Orang-orang kafir) bertanya kepadamu (Muhammad) tentang hari kebangkitan, kapankah terjadinya?

translations.en.sahih: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
translations.en.pickthall: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
translations.en.yusufali: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
translations.id.indonesian: Siapakah kamu (maka) dapat menyebutkan (waktunya)?

translations.en.sahih: To your Lord is its finality.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
translations.id.indonesian: Kepada Tuhanmulah dikembalikan kesudahannya (ketentuan waktunya).

translations.en.sahih: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
translations.en.yusufali: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
translations.id.indonesian: Kamu hanyalah pemberi peringatan bagi siapa yang takut kepadanya (hari berbangkit)

arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
transliteration: Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa

translations.en.sahih: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari mereka melihat hari berbangkit itu, mereka merasa seakan-akan tidak tinggal (di dunia) melainkan (sebentar saja) di waktu sore atau pagi hari.
